system.summary: 700-entry table of numbered words, place and ship names, syllables and single letters (1757 Vaudreuil table), with names and titles left in clear and phonetic spelling.
system.sibling_key: Key found for catalogue 1391 (vaudreuil1760): the 1757 Vaudreuil table ANOM COL C11E 10 f.289 (LAC e001295274); it fits this letter from the first line.
system.notes: Table in numerical order only on the sheet used (the alphabetical sheets e001295267/69 give the same entries by word).

conditions.human_role: Asked for the sibling letters of catalogue 1391 to be decoded and then made into targets of their own.

solution.what: Table found for catalogue 1391 (same hand, same office, months apart) tried on this letter: function words fall in place.
Images fetched from the LAC image server with curl -L (about half the requests need a retry).

Decoded with the table and its context-corrected cells (key/overrides.json); 0 groups sit on a cell still doubtful and 2 are cut at the gutter; the decode reads as French throughout but no reader has reviewed it as sentences.

Reader review: fetched both images and compared every line of f.75r-76r with the transcription; one misread group corrected (393 -> 593, 'l'année prochaine'). Wrote reading.md and reading_en.md; the letter builds sentences throughout.

Two groups written as 389 (m) and 488 (Iroquois) give no sense where the context needs 'seront' and 'd'elle-même'; kept as written, sense supplied. Two cut groups restored (337 loi, 271 r). 'les ju s [?] sont trop grands' (323 + s) not identified.

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The 1757 Vaudreuil table (ANOM COL C11E 10, LAC e001295274), found to fit catalogue 1391 of the same hand, applied to this letter.

texts.label: ANOM, COL C11A 104, ff.75-76 (CABAC_PIAF_60895)
texts.summary: Vaudreuil asks the minister to have the munitionnaire's correspondents in France replace any ship taken, supply ships, and accept freight paid in Canada at this year's rate, and presses for a supplement of provisions on which the preservation of the Colony depends.

reading_review.by: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (a model reading, not a person), after the solving passes
reading_review.note: Read the French sentence by sentence against reading_en.md and the images: the whole letter builds coherent 1759 chancery French (replacement of lost provision ships, freight paid in Canada, request for a supplement of provisions on which the Colony's preservation depends). One wrong group corrected, two groups where the written value does not give the sense, two groups unread. Not checked by a person.

outcome.notes: Read as sentences against the images on 5 Nov 2026 (model reading, no outside reader). Key found, not recovered; table cells read from the images of the volume. Two groups (389, 488) give the wrong value where the sense is clear; kept as written.
